name: Weight
overview: Scripture uses the concept of weight both literally and figuratively to teach spiritual truths. Proverbs 27:3 contrasts physical heaviness with the greater burden of a fool's wrath, while Matthew 23:23 highlights the importance of prioritizing weightier matters like judgment, mercy, and faith over minor details. Believers are encouraged in Hebrews 12:1 to lay aside every weight, especially sin, to run the race of faith with endurance. Additionally, Matthew 6:25 reminds Christians not to be anxious about physical needs, emphasizing the greater value of life beyond material concerns.
